t_advice_summary_textbox.text: It's down to luck - there's nothing you can do about it as it's down to luck and algorithms.

vb_textbox.text: Gnomes' productivity (the no. of mushrooms they harvest) will change over time. Sometimes they harvest a lot over the next few turns, but this will decrease over time. Sometimes they won't harvest a lot for a while - just don't pick them for a few turns and they will start harvesting more mushrooms.
